source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 13. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: Purity before prayer, step by step

learn.en: The Prophet ﷺ taught that prayer is not accepted without purity, so before salah we make wudu with clean water.
learn.title: Purity first

learn.en: Make the intention, say Bismillah, wash both hands three times, rinse the mouth three times, and sniff water into the nose and blow it out gently three times.
learn.title: Hands, mouth, nose

learn.en: Wash the face three times, then the right arm up to the elbow three times, then the left.
learn.title: Face and arms

learn.en: Wipe the head once from front to back and back again, then wipe the ears.
learn.title: Head and ears

learn.en: Wash the feet up to the ankles, right foot first, rubbing between the toes. Then say the du'aa.
learn.title: Feet, then the du'aa
learn.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
learn.tr: Ash-hadu allā ilāha illa-llāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhū wa rasūluh

learn.en: “When you rise to perform prayer, wash your faces and your forearms to the elbows.” (Qur'an 5:6)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

words.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
words.en: After wudu: I bear witness there is no god but Allah… and Muhammad is His servant and Messenger
words.tr: Ash-hadu allā ilāha illa-llāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhū wa rasūluh

order.en: Put the steps of wudu in order

quiz.en: I always wash my ___ foot before my left one.
I rinse my mouth out ___ times.
I wash my face ___ I wash my arms to the elbows.
I sniff water into my nose and give it a ___ blow.

think.q: Can you show Mum or Dad your wudu, step by step, without missing any part?
think.a: Hands, mouth, nose, face, arms, head, ears, feet — then the du'aa!

parents.summary: Wudu step by step: intention and Bismillah; hands, mouth, nose, face (×3); arms to the elbows; wipe head and ears; feet; then the shahada du'aa.
parents.tip: Watch him do wudu once and praise each step he gets right.
